The supplementary statement on the admission period provides a statistical breakdown of hospital stay durations—measured in whole days from arrival to the end of admission—across Danish regions and specific hospital units. Data from the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] reveals significant variation in how long acute surgery patients remain hospitalized depending on the treating institution [^src1].

Nationally, the median admission period in Denmark is 8.00 days, with the first quartile (Q1) at 4.00 days and the third quartile (Q3) at 17.00 days [^src1]. However, this baseline masks extreme disparities at the hospital level. Rigshospitalet stands out as a massive outlier, reporting a median stay of 22.00 days and a Q3 of 42.00 days, which is more than double the national Q3 and the highest in the country by a wide margin [^src1]. Following Rigshospitalet, Sygehus Lillebælt and Aarhus Universitetshospital record the next longest median stays at 12.00 days each [^src1].

Conversely, the shortest median admission periods are found at Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital and the North Jutland Region (Nordjylland Region i alt), both reporting a median of 6.00 days [^src1]. Bornholms Hospital also records a notably short median stay of 6.50 days [^src1]. Other hospitals with relatively brief median stays (7.00 days) include Sjællands Universitetshospital, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital, Hospitalsenhed Midt, and Regionshospitalet Gødstrup [^src1]. 

Because the available data consists of a single reporting period, no longitudinal trends regarding improving or declining admission times can be established. Furthermore, the dataset does not specify explicit clinical targets or thresholds for maximum or ideal admission lengths, meaning no formal assessments of met or missed targets can be made.

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner median og kvartiler for indlæggelsesperiode (i hele dage fra ankomst til afsluttet indlæggelse) mellem regioner og hospitalsenheder for perioden 01/09/2024–31/08/2025, og viser betydelig variation — f.eks. median på 22 dage ved Rigshospitalet mod 6–8 dage ved de fleste andre store hospitalsenheder.
